purpose: Single paired C-caller instrumentation smoke; not comparative inference or calibration
statistical_unit: No inference: one paired instrumentation-smoke window.
preflight: Run only after R100 suite is terminal and router cleanup verified. This one-window smoke checks full paired collection and verifier; no interval or relative performance conclusion.
production: stock C throughout; only new disposable namespace processes are pinned; no governor/IRQ/production affinity changes
failure_rule: Stop on identity, correctness, collection, health, affinity or cleanup failure. Preserve failed window; never infer success from missing results.
design: Two independently started subject daemons pinned CPU 1; one serial client pinned CPU 0. Ten quartets alternating slot ABBA/BAAB, 2000 untimed warmup cycles per segment. Randomized candidate/baseline slot assignment per window and randomized comparator order per suite block. This co-resident comparison is diagnostic, not full-system latency/memory acceptance.
previous_data: C-caller three-side correctness smoke; no C-caller A/A or completed paired measurement yet.
comparison_family: No inference from a single window.
slot_semantics: Both slots use uploaded unmodified ELF bytes; driver implementation=rs selects upload handling, not both languages. Actual implementations are determined by frozen hashes above; stock hash is the exact original C binary.
interpretation_rule: Correctness and instrument validation only. Never combine with R100 Rust-caller data.
